tei:div.tei:p: "y "K oṃ/ ma dag snod bcud stong par sbyangs// stong pa'i ngang las ye shes kyi// rlung me thod sgyed steng nyid du// thod par sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga// rlung mes bskol ba'i dam tshig pa'i// bdud rtsi rab 'bar 'od nyid des// ye shes bdud rtsi spyan drangs nas// dbyer med oṃ dang āḥhūm̐ gis// byin brlabs dri ro mtshungs med gyur// rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam lha tshogs dang*// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong tshogs spyan drangs// mdun gyi nam mkhar sprin bzhin gtibs par gyur// yi dam kun 'dus rtsa ba'i bla ma mchod// dkon mchog kun 'dus rtsa ba'i bla ma mchod// chos skyong kun 'dus rtsa ba'i bla ma mchod// khyad par chos skyong ber gyi na bza' can// dpal ldan lha mo rang byung rgyal mo ni// mched lcam 'khor dang bcas pa mchod par bgyi// rgyal po rnam mang thos sras sngags kyi bdag /rdo rje legs pa srin mgon zhing skyong dang*// mkhar nag rdo rje rgyal po la sogs pa'i// karma pa yi bstan pa skyong rnams la// zag med sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga mchog gi /gtor ma rtsa brgyad pañtsa a mṛ ta// dza gad rakta'i yon chab mchod par bzhes// 'dod yon lnga dang gsang ba'i mchod pa dang*// de kho na yi kun bzang mchod pas mchod// khyod kyi skyon dag yon tan rdzogs pa de'i// gnas tshul ji bzhin rtogs pa'i sgo gsum gyi// bstod pa ma lus pa yis bstod par bgyi// khyod la 'dod don gsol ba btab pa ni// bdag sogs kun la mchog dang thun mong gi /dngos grub stan thog 'di la stsol ba dang*// khyad par tshe ring nad med dpal 'byor rgyas// yid la bsam tshad skad cig tsam nyid la// grub nas karma pa yi bzhed pa kun// bdag gis ma lus myur du 'grub pa dang*// karma pa yi bstan la gnod byed rnams// bdag gis thal ba bzhin du rlog pa yi// nus pa da lta nyid du stsal du gsol// de ltar mchod bstod dad pa'i dge ba des// ma gyur 'gro ba sems can thams cad kun// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas go 'phang 'thob phyir bsngo//
zhes pa 'di ni rin chen dpal mos gsol ba btab pa'i ngor rje btsun karma pa mi bskyod rdo rjes gsungs pa'o/// /
